legal.title: Terms and conditions
legal.termsBody:
Sendero Épico is a companion app for your physical activity: it turns your daily steps (read from Health Connect, with your permission) into progress along an illustrated journey made up of fictional stages and milestones. By using the app, you agree to use it for personal, non-commercial purposes, and you understand that the distances, stages and achievements shown are part of a gamification experience and do not constitute medical or sports advice.

The app may optionally offer additional paid ("premium") features. Any in-app purchase is handled through the corresponding app store (Google Play) and is governed by its own billing and refund terms.

We reserve the right to update these terms as the app evolves. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated version.

We do not guarantee that the app is error-free or continuously available, and we are not responsible for health or training decisions based solely on the data shown in the app.
legal.privacyBody:
Sendero Épico is designed to work with as little data as possible. It does not require creating an account or signing in.

Your progress (steps, km walked, active-day streak) is stored only on your device. The app reads your step count from Health Connect only with your explicit authorization, and that data is never sent to our servers — simply because we don't have servers to receive it.

If future features are added that involve sending or storing data outside your device (for example, to sync across devices or manage premium purchases), we will update this policy to explain exactly what data is shared and for what purpose, before turning them on.

You can revoke Health Connect permission at any time from your Android system settings, and you can delete all stored data by uninstalling the app.

If you have questions about this policy, you can contact the developer through the app's Google Play listing.

aldea-natal.name: The Home Village
aldea-natal.description: A quiet village among green hills, the starting point.

limite-conocido.name: The Known Edge
limite-conocido.description: The farthest point any villager had ever reached.

huerto.name: The Orchard
huerto.description: Farmland just outside the village, a tempting shortcut.
huerto.achievement: Just borrowing a couple of carrots

embarcadero.name: The Ferry Crossing
embarcadero.description: A river crossing by boat, the last easy way out before the unknown.

el-puente.name: The Bridge
el-puente.description: Crossing here means truly leaving home behind.

posada-del-poni.name: The Tired Pony Inn
posada-del-poni.description: A crossroads tavern, full of rumors and curious stares.

guia-misterioso.name: On the Road with the Mysterious Guide
guia-misterioso.description: A lone traveler offers to accompany the group through dangerous roads.

cima-ventosa.name: Windy Top
cima-ventosa.description: An old, exposed hill, a bad place to camp.

ciudad-de-los-elfos.name: The City of the Ancient Elves
ciudad-de-los-elfos.description: A hidden refuge in a valley, the last breath before the wild lands.
ciudad-de-los-elfos.achievement: The Fellowship of the Journey is born

cumbres-heladas-1.name: The Frozen Peaks
cumbres-heladas-1.description: An imposing mountain range that must be crossed or skirted.

paso-de-la-nieve.name: The Snow Pass
paso-de-la-nieve.description: A mountain pass that seems to resist letting them through.
paso-de-la-nieve.achievement: A cruel voice rides the wind

bajada-de-la-montana.name: The Mountain Descent
bajada-de-la-montana.description: The way down, every bit as hard as the climb.

entrada-minas-profundas.name: The Entrance to the Deep Mines
entrada-minas-profundas.description: An ancient door sealed with a riddle, carved into the rock.
entrada-minas-profundas.achievement: Only those who know the word may pass

salida-minas-profundas.name: The Way Out of the Deep Mines
salida-minas-profundas.description: Something woke down there, and not everyone comes out the same.
salida-minas-profundas.achievement: The last barrier before the way out

bosque-dorado.name: The Golden Forest
bosque-dorado.description: A forest where time seems to stand still among golden leaves.
bosque-dorado.achievement: Welcome, one who has felt the shadow

estatuas-de-los-reyes.name: The Statues of the Ancient Kings
estatuas-de-los-reyes.description: Two colossal figures carved into the rock, watching over the river passage.

separacion-de-la-hermandad.name: Where the Fellowship Parts Ways
separacion-de-la-hermandad.description: The group can no longer stay together for the rest of the journey.

cumbres-heladas-2.name: The Frozen Peaks, Once More
cumbres-heladas-2.description: Another mountain range, this time with no one left to guide the way.

descenso-de-la-montana.name: The Mountain Descent
descenso-de-la-montana.description: Something has been following close behind for a while now.

camino-al-porton-sombrio.name: The Road to the Shadowed Gate
camino-al-porton-sombrio.description: A strange creature offers, in its own way, to act as a guide.

paso-de-la-cienaga.name: The Marsh Crossing
paso-de-la-cienaga.description: Stagnant waters where reflections float that are better left unseen.
paso-de-la-cienaga.achievement: He's led us into a swamp

porton-sombrio.name: The Shadowed Gate
porton-sombrio.description: The main entrance to enemy lands, watched day and night.
porton-sombrio.achievement: There's another way, though no one remembers it

aliado-inesperado.name: An Unexpected Ally
aliado-inesperado.description: Another band of armed travelers blocks their path.
aliado-inesperado.achievement: Turns out he was his brother

cueva-de-la-cascada.name: The Waterfall Cave
cueva-de-la-cascada.description: A secret hideout behind a curtain of water.

ciudad-en-ruinas.name: The Ruined, Besieged City
ciudad-en-ruinas.description: A half-abandoned city, under constant siege.

escalera-de-las-minas-verdes.name: The Stair of the Green Mines
escalera-de-las-minas-verdes.description: A steep, forgotten shortcut carved into the hillside.

guarida-de-la-arana.name: The Spider's Lair
guarida-de-la-arana.description: A tunnel that smells of something far bigger than an ordinary web.

pelea-con-la-arana.name: The Fight with the Spider
pelea-con-la-arana.description: The darkest moment of the journey so far.
pelea-con-la-arana.achievement: Don't go where I can't follow — wake up!

huida-de-los-enemigos.name: Fleeing the Enemy
huida-de-los-enemigos.description: Captured and freed, now it's time to stay unseen.
huida-de-los-enemigos.achievement: Needs another disguise to carry on

camino-a-la-torre-oscura.name: The Road to the Dark Tower
camino-a-la-torre-oscura.description: The shadowlands, within sight of the enemy fortress.

bajo-la-sombra-de-la-torre.name: Under the Tower's Shadow
bajo-la-sombra-de-la-torre.description: Enemy troops withdraw toward another front.

la-montana-de-fuego.name: The Mountain of Fire
la-montana-de-fuego.description: The final destination: an active volcano at the heart of the shadowlands.
la-montana-de-fuego.achievement: Few guarantees, no certainties... but it has to be tried

donde-dejan-el-equipaje.name: Where They Leave the Gear Behind
donde-dejan-el-equipaje.description: No need to carry anything more for the final stretch.
donde-dejan-el-equipaje.achievement: A weight that no longer needs carrying

cima-de-la-montana-de-fuego.name: The Summit of the Mountain of Fire
